plan.name: Show every running step on the dashboard, live
plan.summary: `/api/live.json` lists every step the shown watcher is running with an agent at work, building, drafting or answering (D-0113), each read from its own issue's newest step directory in that watcher's work directory, its transcript only as far as it's new and its checks' log, with its own issue, doing and since, the watcher's time limit, and the same counts, times and paths as now and nothing more (D-0051, D-0116), longest-running first; a status that lists no steps counts as the one step its issue, doing and since name, a step that's doing nothing yet or ratifying isn't listed, and once none of a repository's steps is running, the steps last read for it stay listed, marked ended, until one runs again, as the one step does now. The watcher writes its lease name to its status file as `holder` (Status.Holder, set from Factory.Holder in cmd/invariant/main.go, whose `-work` help changes to match), the server keeps each repository's lease holder as it last read it where the live view can read it without a race, and with several work directories the live view and the headline both show the running watcher whose status names that holder, falling back to today's choice, the one working, when the lease is unknown or names none of them. The snapshot's watcher lists its running steps (Watcher.Steps), and the headline names every step that's doing something across the repositories it covers, grouped by what each is doing, the groups in the order of their longest-running step and each group's issues longest-running first, as "Building #148 and #150 · drafting #152", the words being building, drafting, answering and committing the ratification on; `now.running` counts those steps, and with more than one the chip beside the headline says "3 steps running" in place of "The factory is working", the hero shows no single step's check chips and no detail line, while with one the headline, detail and chips are exactly as now. The page's live section becomes a list of cards, one for each step in scope, the running ones or else the ended ones as now, in the live view's order, each cloned from `<template id="live-card">` in index.html with its own title, now line, dial, stats, heartbeat strip, legend, checks and files, found by the classes live-title, live-now, dial, live-stats, strip, legend, live-runs and live-files instead of ids, and kept across reads by repository, issue and since, so its dial and strip never start over, it arrives as the panel does now and leaves when its step leaves the list, and one running step looks as the panel does now. SPEC.md's lines on the status file and the live view say the page shows each running step and follows the lease holder's watcher, internal/dashboard's own tests are updated and extended to match, and since cmd/invariant/main.go is in the trusted base, a person merges it and records the decision that refines D-0116.

tests.name: TestTheLiveViewListsEveryRunningStep
tests.says: With three steps running in one watcher's work directory, two builds, one of them a plumbing build, and a draft, `/api/live.json` lists all three, longest-running first, each with its own issue, what it's doing, since when and the watcher's time limit, and its own turns, thinking, context, tool calls, files and checks read from its own transcript and log; a step doing nothing yet, a ratifying step and another issue's old step directory aren't listed.

tests.name: TestTheLiveViewShowsTheLeaseHoldersWatcher
tests.says: With steps running in two watchers' work directories, `/api/live.json` lists exactly the steps of the watcher whose status names the holder of the repository's lease, read through GitHub, even when it's the second work directory, and when the lease moves to the other watcher, exactly that one's steps.

tests.name: TestTheHeadlineNamesEveryRunningStep
tests.says: While the watcher builds #148 and #150 and drafts #152, with #155 doing nothing yet, the snapshot's headline is "Building #148 and #150 · drafting #152" and it counts 3 steps running; once only #148's build runs, the headline is "Writing the code for #148" and it counts 1, as now.

tests.name: TestThePageDrawsACardForEachStep
tests.says: The page's live section holds its cards, made from one card template with its own title, now line, dial, stats, heartbeat strip, legend, checks and files; no part of a step's card is an element id, which a page can have only one of, and the script neither reads those ids nor misses the template, and its chip says how many steps are running.
